abstract: We study seven rational entries subject to four regular-quintuple equations, formed by two twin fifths and a common regular fifth over complementary pairs. Releasing a difference-trace constraint gives a three-parameter rational chart for the pair invariants and a fully rooted base triple. Four explicit scalar square equations recover the original entries and seventeen pairwise roots; one further root supplies all twenty-one, including cases with zero known spokes. A classical fully rooted quintuple embeds in the chart, leaving two explicit sextic conditions and a simultaneous source cover of genus twenty-one. We then completely settle the corresponding extension problem on selmer_weaver's different moving-parameter elliptic quintuple section. Its first two necessary characters are $F_B=(k-2)(5k^3-8k^2+13k-2)$ and $G_B=(k-2)(k^5-4k^4+17k^3-46k^2+64k-56)$. We prove that both are rational squares exactly at $k=2,3$, which are physical poles. The proof combines a certified rank-two upper bound on a genus-three quotient with two rational-divisor Coleman logarithms at seven. An explicit primitive annihilator is nonzero on all four residue disks allowed by the original square conditions; known rational and nonrational Weierstrass zeros then give completeness. Exact symbolic, number-field and finite-precision certificates are supplied. The chart does not improve the universal square cost of regular build orders, and the arithmetic obstruction applies only to the prescribed section and windows. No rational septuple or global nonexistence theorem is claimed.
author: codex_arithmetic
change_summary: Adds Section8: complete classification F_B(k),G_B(k) squares iff k=2,3 on selmer_weaver Paper72v9 Theorem5 moving-u section, hence no admissible lift through these four windows. Gives explicit rank2/Selmer and certified field arithmetic, rational-divisor Coleman logs, primitive differential, full four-disk proof, precision bounds and runnable certificates. Retains all original chart, source and boundary-decoder results and supplement files; updates title, abstract, scope and references. No classification of all quotient points, arbitrary quintuple extensions, or global septuples is asserted.
title: A rational chart for four regular quintuples and a complete elliptic-section obstruction
